headlines.title: 中国央行：二季度末人民币房地产贷款余额50.74万亿元，同比下降4.9%
headlines.summary: 中国央行发布2026年二季度金融机构贷款投向统计报告。报告提到，2026年二季度末，人民币房地产贷款余额50.74万亿元，同比下降4.9%，上半年减少1.23万亿元。

headlines.title_en: China's central bank: RMB real estate loan balance at end of Q2 was 50.74 trillion yuan, down 4.9% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: China's central bank released a report on financial institution loan allocations for Q2 2026, stating that RMB real estate loans stood at 50.74 trillion yuan at end-Q2, down 4.9% year-on-year, with a first-half decrease of 1.23 trillion yuan.

headlines.title: 人民银行上海总部：上半年长三角地区人民币存款增加4.67万亿元
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行上海总部发布2026年上半年长三角地区货币信贷运行情况。6月末，长三角地区本外币各项存款余额91.89万亿元，同比增长8.3%。其中，人民币存款余额88.8万亿元，同比增长8.2%；外币存款余额4545亿美元，同比增长14.4%。

headlines.title_en: PBOC Shanghai HQ: RMB deposits in Yangtze River Delta region increased by 4.67 trillion yuan in H1
headlines.summary_en: The PBOC Shanghai Headquarters released data on monetary and credit operations in the Yangtze River Delta for the first half of 2026. headlines.title: 《财富》世界500强排行榜揭晓：亚马逊登顶，沃尔玛第二，中国国家电网第三
headlines.summary: 今年《财富》世界500强排行榜企业的营业收入总和约为43.1万亿美元，超过全球GDP的三分之一，比去年增长了约3.2%。此次上榜门槛（最低销售收入）从322亿美元增长至332亿美元，较一年前提高3%。所有上榜公司的净利润总和同比大幅增长约14%，约为3.4万亿美元。500家上榜公司的资产总额和净资产总额均达到自《财富》世界500强排行榜创立以来的最高峰，且雇佣员工总数相比去年有所增长。 亚马逊成为全球最大公司，终结了沃尔玛连续十二年的领跑纪录。沃尔玛位列第二。中国的国家电网有限公司继续位列第三。排在第四和第五位的分别是联合健康集团和沙特阿美公司。

headlines.title_en: Fortune Global 500 unveiled: Amazon tops, Walmart second, China's State Grid third
headlines.summary_en: This year's Fortune Global 500 companies had total revenues of approximately $43.1 trillion, exceeding one-third of global GDP and up about 3.2% year-on-year. The entry threshold rose from $32.2 billion to $33.2 billion, up 3% from a year ago. Total net profits of listed companies surged about 14% year-on-year to roughly $3.4 trillion. Both total assets and net assets of the 500 firms hit record highs since the list's inception, and total employee count increased. Amazon became the world's largest company, ending Walmart's 12-year streak; Walmart ranked second. China's State Grid Corporation remained third, with UnitedHealth Group and Saudi Aramco in fourth and fifth.

headlines.title: 德国央行称伊朗冲突冲击下 德国经济料仍实现增长
headlines.summary: 德国央行表示，德国经济第二季度可能实现温和增长，这一增长势头预计将延续至第三季度。德国央行周二表示，4月至6月期间，德国经济产出可能“小幅增长”。这一判断较此前预计的经济停滞更为乐观，不过，7月至9月的经济增速预计将有所放缓。德国央行在月度报告中表示，“总体而言，当前一系列经济指标显示，德国经济的潜在增长率略高于我们在6月预测中的预期。”

headlines.title_en: German central bank says German economy still expected to grow despite Iran conflict impact
headlines.summary_en: The German central bank stated that the German economy likely saw moderate growth in Q2, expected to continue into Q3. On Tuesday, it said economic output may have 'grown slightly' from April to June, more optimistic than its previous estimate of stagnation, though growth is expected to slow in July-September. In its monthly report, it noted that 'overall, current economic indicators suggest Germany's potential growth rate is slightly higher than our June forecast.'

headlines.title: 何立峰出席2026年亚太经合组织林业部长级会议开幕式并致辞
headlines.summary: 中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理何立峰28日在深圳出席2026年亚太经合组织林业部长级会议开幕式并致辞。 何立峰强调，亚太是全球森林资源最富集、生态系统类型最多样的地区之一，森林面积占全球一半以上。中国始终致力于维护全球生态安全，传播生态文化和绿色理念，为亚太地区乃至全球生态文明建设贡献了中国智慧、中国方案。在各方共同努力下，亚太地区成为扭转全球森林资源下降趋势的主要力量。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: He Lifeng attends and addresses opening ceremony of 2026 APEC Ministerial Meeting on Forestry
headlines.summary_en: On July 28, He Lifeng, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier, attended and addressed the opening ceremony of the 2026 APEC Ministerial Meeting on Forestry in Shenzhen. He emphasized that the Asia-Pacific is one of the regions with the richest forest resources and most diverse ecosystems, accounting for over half of global forest area. China is committed to maintaining global ecological security and spreading ecological culture and green concepts, contributing Chinese wisdom and solutions to ecological civilization in the region and the world. Through joint efforts, the Asia-Pacific has become a main force reversing the global forest decline. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 香港特区政府与国家工信部签署《关于推进部港共建制造业创新中心的合作协议》
headlines.summary: 香港特区政府与国家工业和信息化部28日在特区政府总部签署《关于推进部港共建制造业创新中心的合作协议》。 香港特区政府创新科技及工业局局长孙东和国家工业和信息化部副部长熊继军分别代表香港特区政府与国家工业和信息化部签署合作协议。此项合作协议旨在切实推进双方于2024年9月签署的《关于发展新质生产力推进新型工业化的合作协议》，深化内地和香港产业合作，促进香港更好融入和服务国家发展大局，共同支持在香港建设制造业创新中心。

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong SAR government signs cooperation agreement with MIIT on advancing ministry-HK co-built manufacturing innovation center
headlines.summary_en: On July 28, the Hong Kong SAR Government and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology signed a cooperation agreement at the SAR Government Headquarters to advance the construction of a manufacturing innovation center in Hong Kong. Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong and Vice Minister Xiong Jijun signed on behalf of the SAR Government and MIIT, respectively. This agreement aims to implement the September 2024 agreement on developing new quality productive forces and advancing new industrialization, deepening industry cooperation between the mainland and Hong Kong, and supporting the construction of a manufacturing innovation center in Hong Kong.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai-listed 2025 annual report dividends distributed over 1 trillion yuan, Red Low Vol ETF net inflow nearly 23 billion yuan
headlines.summary_en: As of July 28, cash dividends for the 2025 fiscal year from Shanghai-listed companies have exceeded 1 trillion yuan, with about 120 billion yuan in remaining dividends to be distributed soon. By July 28, 29 companies had cumulative actual dividends over 10 billion yuan, including ICBC, China Mobile, and CCB exceeding 100 billion yuan, and ABC, PetroChina, and Kweichow Moutai exceeding 50 billion yuan. Meanwhile, low-volatility dividend ETFs are attracting new capital; from January to July 27, Shanghai-listed ETFs distributed 20.8 billion yuan in dividends, 95% of the domestic total, with two CSI 300 ETFs distributing over 4.5 billion yuan each. Dividend ETFs have seen net inflows of nearly 23 billion yuan since the start of 2026, with significant inflows in July.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance: National lottery sales in June totaled 75.978 billion yuan, up 39.5% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: Ministry of Finance: China's lottery sales in June totaled 75.978 billion yuan, up 39.5% year-on-year. Cumulative sales from January to June reached 326.874 billion yuan, up 90.20 billion yuan or 2.8% from a year ago.

headlines.title: 上交所协议回购出资人展示名单扩容，新纳入8家金融机构
headlines.summary: 上海证券交易所发布《上海证券交易所债券质押式协议回购业务出资人信息展示（2026年7月更新）》，首次对展示信息进行集中更新。记者注意到，最新展示的协议回购出资人名单已扩展至22家，与首批名单相比，新纳入8家金融机构；同时，部分已展示机构的可接受质押券种范围及业务联络人信息亦同步更新。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai Stock Exchange expands list of protocol repo funders, adds 8 financial institutions
headlines.summary_en: Shanghai Stock Exchange released 'Information Display of Funding Providers for Bond Pledged Repo Agreements (Updated July 2026),' the first centralized update. The latest list has expanded to 22 institutions, adding eight financial institutions compared to the initial list; information on acceptable pledge bonds and business contacts for some existing providers has also been updated.

headlines.title: 生态环境部：推动建立生态环境损害赔偿制度规范体系
headlines.summary: 生态环境部法规与标准司司长赵柯28日在例行新闻发布会上表示，为落实生态环境法典规定，进一步推动受损生态环境得到有效修复，将开展以下工作：一是进一步加强立法，推进部门规章的研究编制，推动形成以生态环境法典为统领、相关配套制度为支撑的生态环境损害赔偿制度规范体系。二是加强鉴定评估技术保障，推动生态环境损害智能评估（e评估）系统建设，扩大智能评估应用覆盖面。三是进一步提升生态环境损害修复实效，健全“损害赔偿－生态修复－效果评估”全链条闭环管理模式。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment: Promote establishment of standardized system for ecological damage compensation
headlines.summary_en: Zhao Ke, director of the Ministry of Ecology and Environment's Department of Laws, Regulations, and Standards, said at a regular press conference on July 28 that to implement the Ecological Environment Code and promote effective restoration of damaged ecosystems, the following work will be carried out: firstly, strengthening legislation to advance research and drafting of departmental regulations, forming a compensation system guided by the Code and supported by related rules; secondly, enhancing technical support for assessment, promoting the development of a smart ecological damage assessment (e-assessment) system to expand its coverage; thirdly, improving the actual effectiveness of ecological restoration by improving a closed-loop management chain of 'damage compensation - ecological restoration - effect evaluation.' (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 生态环境部：抓紧推进生态环境法典配套制度的制修订
headlines.summary: 生态环境部法规与标准司司长赵柯28日在例行新闻发布会上透露，生态环境部将积极担当、主动作为，按程序抓紧推进生态环境法典配套制度的制修订工作，做好与法典的衔接，确保各项制度规定能接得住、接得稳、接得顺，最大限度地保障好法典的落地。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment: Accelerate revision of supporting systems for ecological code
headlines.summary_en: Zhao Ke, director of the Ministry of Ecology and Environment's Department of Laws, Regulations, and Standards, said at a regular press conference on July 28 that the Ministry will actively take action and promptly advance the formulation and revision of supporting systems for the Ecological Environment Code, ensuring smooth integration and effective implementation of the Code. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 商务部：中国不是欧盟面临经贸问题的根源 而是解决问题的伙伴
headlines.summary: 商务部政策研究室主任林卫龙28日在国新办新闻发布会上表示，中国不是欧盟面临经贸问题的根源，而是解决问题的伙伴。保护主义没有出路，合作共赢才是正道。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: China is not the root of EU's economic problems but a partner in solving them
headlines.summary_en: Lin Weilong, head of the Ministry of Commerce's Policy Research Office, said at a State Council Information Office press conference on July 28 that China is not the root cause of the EU's economic problems but a partner in solving them; protectionism offers no way out, and win-win cooperation is the right path. (Shanghai Securities News)
